tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Returns the connected account identity. Requires account authorization; unauthenticated calls request OAuth. Public catalog browsing and creating a new board do not require probing account identity.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: Returns the connected account’s organizations and membership roles. Requires account authorization. Use the returned organizationId with list_boards or create_board for organization work; omit organizationId for personal boards.

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Searches published catalog components. Supply known catalog filters such as category and exact package. Use query for the remaining terms or exact MPN. tools.name: get_part
tools.description: Returns a published catalog part and verified pins. Skip this call when search_parts already supplied the needed pins and facts. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_board, create_board, update_board, check_board_layout, export_board · Private data: submit_feedback, list_boards, get_board, save_board_to_account, create_board, get_generation, export_board · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: create_board, update_board, delete_board, export_board.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_board, create_board, update_board, check_board_layout, export_board · Private data: submit_feedback, list_boards, get_board, save_board_to_account, create_board, get_generation, export_board · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: create_board, update_board, delete_board, export_board

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
